title: Did anyone just dream they were on a cruise?
content: I know it’s not “a mall” but in terms of shared dream location this one seemed interestingly real. I just woke up from a dream of this location about 15-20 mins ago (3:20am EST). It was a cruise ship but not like one of the crazy big ones. I think it was white and blue and looked a little dated. There wasn’t a giant pool in the middle of the ship but more towards the back there was a small pool or maybe a hot tub covered by the floor above it. If I remember right it was more for a half day cruise to some island and back but I’m not sure.
